##### **Executive Summary** 

##### **Highlights of international copper mar

ket** 

In Q2 2012, average copper price on LME and 3 month average price on LME was US$7,866/t and US$7,827/t respectively, down by 5.31% and 5.83% q-o-q, or down by 14.05% and 14.64% y-o-y, respectively. 

In Q2 2012, global refined copper output was 4.946Mt, up by 4.6% y-o-y or 3.4% q-o-q; consumption was 4.95Mt, up by 0.6% y-o-y or 3.1% q-o-q. The y-o-y growth rate of global refined copper output in Q1 was obviously higher than that of consumption. 

Affected by strike, low ore grade, unexpected weather and shortage of large-scale mining projects and other factors, global copper concentrate output in 2011 almost has seen no growth. 

Global copper concentrate was 6.45Mt in H1 2012, up by 4.4% y-o-y; demand was 6.53Mt, up by 5.2% y-o-y. The shortage of supply and demand was 80kt. Of which, copper concentrate output in Q2 was 3.25Mt, up by 4.5% y-o-y or 1.6% q-o-q; demand was 3.3Mt, up by 4.8% y-o-y or 2.2% q-o-q. The growth rate of demand was slight higher than output, which caused the copper concentrate staying in short supply. 

##### **Global refined copper output up in Q2** 

In H1 2012, global refined copper output increased by 3.0% to 9.73Mt, the increment came mainly from China and Africa etc. During major refined copper producing countries, output in China, India and Zambia grew stably; due to earthquake and tsunami in March, output in Japan increased obviously; that of other South America and European Counties generally increased slightly, cancelling the gap of individual countries. Of which, output in main refined copper producing countries in Q2 was higher than that in Q1. 

In respect of consumption, dragged down by inadequate growth of global economy, copper consumption in developed countries was weakened, with the help of contribution from some emerging countries, global consumption in H1 2012 increased slightly by 1.6% to 9.75Mt, the growth rate fell by half. You can see from the consumption in main refined copper consumption countries, consumption in many countries all declined, expect the fast growth in India, as well as the growth in Japan due to earthquake and tsunami and the slight growth in China. Like that of output, the overall consumption in Q2 was better than Q1. 

In Q2 2012, global refined copper output was 4.946Mt, up by 4.6% y-o-y or 3.4% q-o-q; consumption was 4.95Mt, up by 0.6% y-o-y or 3.1% q-o-q. The y-o-y growth rate of global refined copper output in Q1 was obviously higher than that of consumption. 

As a whole, global copper market in H1 2012 stayed in a state of slight shortage, but due to large Chinese import, markets outside China appeared supply shortage, and have become an 

4 

important factor to support copper price. However, shortage in Q2 narrowed but basically kept stable, comparing with Q1.

##### **Global copper concentrate supply slightly tight** 

Affected by strike, low ore grade, unexpected weather and shortage of large-scale mining projects and other factors, global copper concentrate output in 2011 almost has seen no growth. 

In 2012, mine strike was uncommon and supply increased steadily, but due to the decreasing output of Grasberg and other mines, the growth rate of global copper concentrate increased slightly; meanwhile, copper concentrate demand was strong, especially refining capacity expansion was still continuing in China, and without influence of Japanese earthquake and tsunami in March, therefore, copper concentrate supply appeared a slight shortage. 

Global copper concentrate was 6.45Mt in H1 2012, up by 4.4% y-o-y; demand was 6.53Mt, up by 5.2% y-o-y. The shortage of supply and demand was 80kt. Of which, copper concentrate output in Q2 was 3.25Mt, up by 4.5% y-o-y or 1.6% q-o-q; demand was 3.3Mt, up by 4.8% y-o-y or 2.2% q-o-q. The growth rate of demand was slight higher than output, which caused the copper concentrate staying in short supply.

##### **Highlights of Chinese copper market** 

In Q2 2012, average copper price on SHFE and 3 month average price on SHFE was 56,420yuan/t and 66,094yuan/t respectively, down by 4.76% and 5.73% q-o-q, or down by 18.50% and 18.29% y-o-y, respectively. 

In Q2, domestic refined copper import was less than that in Q1, but export increased greatly. Refined copper production only had a small rise in Q2, which made refined copper supply declined by 15.4% compared with that in Q1 to 1.98Mt. Domestic refined copper consumption increased to 1.99Mt in Q2, up by 3.6% YoY and 13.1% compared to that in Q1. In Q2, domestic refined copper supply and demand was basically in balance. 

Antaike estimates that domestic refined copper production will increase by 8% YoY to 5.60Mt in 2012, with overall refined copper market in great surplus 

##### **Chinese Copper Price** 

##### **Copper price is declining** 

Copper price gradually decreased since Apr. 2012 and it almost kept on a unilateral downtrend; it fluctuated low in Jun., copper price on Jun. 22 decreased to US$7,220/t, touching a historic low in

2012. However, due to the expectation for EU summits and bail-out agreement, commodity and financial market were gotten a boost. As investors covered short position actively, the biggest single-day rise since Nov. 2011 was appeared on the last trading day in H1 2012, copper price closed at US$7,685/t, up by 1.1% compared with US$7,600/t by the end of 2011, being the best among base metals. But in terms of Q2 2012, the decreasing rate was the biggest since Q3 2011. In Q2 2012, average copper price on LME and 3 month average price on LME was US$7,866/t and US$7,827/t respectively, down by 5.31% and 5.83% q-o-q, or down by 14.05% and 14.64% y-o-y, respectively. The copper price on domestic market continued to follow the LME price in Q2, which began to move down in Apr., decreased in May and stayed stable in Jun. The copper price touched a new low since the beginning of 2012 at 52,700yuan/t on Jun. 4. With the decreasing copper import and the big increasing copper export, the ratio of LME copper price to SHFE has been restored gradually, although it did not restored to the reasonable level, it has been improved. In Q2 2012, average copper price on SHFE and 3 month average price on SHFE was 56,420yuan/t and 66,094yuan/t respectively, down by 4.76% and 5.73% q-o-q, or down by 18.50% and 18.29% y-o-y, respectively. 6 **Table 3 Average Copper Price on LME and SHFE** ||**LME**（U

**_-18.29%_**| ##### **Changes of open interests at major Exchanges** In Q2 2012, the market still worried about Europe Debt Crisis, people questioned US economic recovery, although Fed officials prolonged operation twist, the market condition should not be blindly optimistic, Chinese demand and economic data was not satisfying, as the above factors, the buyers did not chase the rising price, in the meanwhile the long positions would lock the profit while copper price reached higher. Based on the worry of market prospect, the capital was withdrawing copper market, the open interest of LME kept decreasing this year and it decreased to 247,000 lots in late

Jun., touching the lowest since H2 2009. Among the open interest of COMEX, the COMEX fund transferred from long positions to short positions in the middle of May and increased above 16,000 lots by the end of Jun, hitting a highest since H2 2009; actually the buyers did not decrease much, but the sellers added positions actively. In the case of poor macro situation, the long positions had no ability to promote the price. The open interests of SHFE increased, the buyers bought on the dips but the sellers was comparatively more active than the buyers, overall, the game of sellers and buyers would continue and become more and more intense. 7 **Chart 1 Open Interest on World’s Top Three Nonferrous Metals Exchanges** SHFE LME Comex

##### **Copper inventory changes on LME and SHFE** In Q1 2012, copper inventory on LME continued to decrease, the main reason was the big increasing Chinese copper import, and the same reason also led to the large rise of copper inventory on SHFE, thus large Chinese refined copper import was not pushed by consumption demand. After Apr., due to high inventory on Chinese bonded warehouse, the price abroad was higher than domestic price, Chinese market urged to destock inventory, Chinese import decreased and export increased, copper inventory on LME decreased slightly, even began to rebound as well as copper inventory on SHFE decreased back to the level of early 2012. Inventory changes at home and abroad and Chinese import and export led to the conjecture and estimation of real Chinese copper consumption, which also be an important factor affecting the copper price trend. Especially Chinese destocking behavior, although it was hard to promote this behavior under background of overall weak condition, the behavior still leased the pressure from supply surplus in environment of weakened demand, thus domestic price became defensive and further resumed the ratio of copper price at home to abroad. As for hyped “Valuation” event between Glencore Coercing Position and JCCL’s export, in hindsight, it was possible that the normal market practice from both sides, so the influence of this event was limited. 8 **Chart 2 Inventory and Closing Price of LME 3-M Cu** 600000 10500

##### **Sulfuric acid prices maintains stable** 

In Q1, sulfuric acid stock was high and hard to be released for a while. Chemical fertilizer demand stayed sluggish, due to low temperature and less rainfall during this period. In Q1, domestic sulfuric acid average price fluctuated in the line of 410yuan/t. After entering into Q2, near export off-season of chemical fertilizer enterprises came to finish container gate-in for phosphate fertilizer and wait for exports, which relieved a certain pressure on domestic sulfuric acid stock. At that time, sulfuric acid prices increased slightly in Guangxi and Yunnan. On the whole, domestic sulfuric acid average price was at 414.5yuan/t in H1 2012, at 415.3 yuan/t in Q2, slightly higher than 413.7yuan/t in Q1. 

In Q3, with the coming of chemical fertilizer export off-season, It is estimated that domestic sulfuric acid demand will have certain improvement in Q3, but less influence on sulfuric acid prices. Mass imported sulphur in H1 of 2012 was not good for sulfuric acid price, although sulphur prices stayed strong. Antaike estimates that quarterly average price in Q3 will be at the level of 420yuan/t.

##### **Chinese Copper Material Supply** 

##### **Mining capacity** 

Domestic copper concentrate capacity to be completed and put into operation, will reach 100ktpy or above in 2012, including several expansion projects in Jiangxi Copper Co. and Duomaoshang Mine Deposit of Zijinshan Mining. Domestic actually newly-added copper concentrate capacity will be about 70kt in 2012, because Dexing Copper Mine’s expansion project has been put into operation in succession since 2009. Chinese mining expansion projects under construction are as follows: 

**Xinxin Mining Co., Ltd** ’s Huangshan Cu-Ni Mine’s 4,000t/d project started in June, 2010. The mine locates in Hami City, Xinjiang with 84Mt of Cu-Ni ore reserves, including 380kt of nickel content, 220kt of copper content and 32kt of cobalt content. The project with total investment of 1bln yuan will be commissioned in H1 2012. 

**Jiangxi Copper** ’s Dexing Copper Mine expansion project is expected to be finished completely in 2012 on schedule. Overall investment budget will reach 2.7bln yuan. After the whole project being commissioned, its mining capacity will rise to 130kt/d from current 100kt/d. Newly-added output will include 41kt copper-in-concentrate, 61kg gold and 25t silver. 

*

*Chengmenshan Copper Mine** ’s stage 2 of expansion project was kicked off in December, 2009. The stage 2 with investment of 500mln yuan was constructed for 2 years, which has 

10 

been put into production at the end of 2011. Now, the project was in trial run. Project can process 7000t/d of ores and produce 14.8kt/y of copper after it reaches the designed capacity. **Jiangxi Yinshan Mining Co., Ltd** ’s 5,000t/d mining project with total investment of 500mln yuan started in 2010. After completion, it is expected to produce 6,821t metal copper. The project has been put into trial run at the end of 2011. **Jiangxi Copper** planned to produce 210kt copper –in-concentrate in 2012, up by 3.96% compared with 202kt in 2011, greatly lower than 17.44% of 2011. 

**Zinjin Mining Holdings Group Co., Ltd** ’s Zinjinshan Copper Mine with total investment of 582mln yuan will establish two ore dressing plants which can process 10kt/d and 8,000t/d of ores respectively. And it will also establish a 45kt/d grinding system project. Reconstruction and follow-up reformation project of Zijinshan hydrometallurgy plant has been basically finished and most of the project will be put into operation before the end of 2012. 

**Tuwu Copper Mine** , in Hami, Xinjiang Autonomous Region, started construction on Feb. 25, 2010. The project is planned to be finished by two stages. The first stage will adopt open pit method and underground mining method. Stage 1 was put into run in the end of 2011. After that it will be capable of processing 5kt ores per day in stage 1, and the processing capacity will be expanded to 10kt in stage 2. The project is invested by Xinjiang Huajin Copper Co., Ltd. under Central Asia Yanxin Copper Co., Ltd. 

Heilongjiang **Duobaoshan Copper-Molybdenum Mine** is invested by Heilongjiang Duobaoshan Copper Co., Ltd. (Duobaoshan Copper) with a total investment of 3.0bln yuan and planned to be finished by two stages. The first stage was put into trial run on May 28 of 2012. After that it will be capable of processing 25kt ores per day and 7.50Mt per year, and producing 117,648t copper concentrates (25% Cu, about 30kt metal copper) and 1,401t molybdenum concentrates (45% Mo) per year.  When the second stage being commissioned, 50kt ores can be processed per day, and outputs of copper concentrates (25% Cu) and molybdenum concentrates (45% Mo) will reach 233,316t and 3,014 t respectively. Time table of stage 2 has not been revealed. 

**Xinjiang Hudehe Copper mine** 's 6Mtpy copper mining project kicked off on Sep. 16, 2011, which is a large-scale porphyry copper deposit in Toli County, Tacheng Prefecture, Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, with proven reserve was 362.5kt metal copper, and 1Mt prospective reserve. The preliminary scheme is to complete 6Mtpy mining project, with total investment budget of 1.466 bln yuan. After being put into production, the project is estimated to produce 15kt copper-in-concentrate. 

**Tongling Tongshan Mining Company** ’s d

eep mining project started in September of 2011. The project’s designed ores processing capacity is 2kt/d and 660kt/y. The project is designed to produce 5kt copper per year. Growth rate of investment, floor space under construction slowed down and starting floor space of houses declined by 4.3% with the same period of 2011; sales area of commercial houses decline by 12.4%. Investment in power generation decreased by down by 1.96% YoY, but investment portion in clean energies rises. According to statistics from China Electricity Council, during Jan to May, completed investment in national power construction was 214.6 billion yuan, up by 1.21% YoY. Among them, investment in power generation and power grid reached 114.3 billion yuan and 100.3 billion yuan, down by 1.96% or up by 5.08% YoY, respectively. Of investment in power generation, investment in thermal power was 29.5 billion yuan, down by 25.26% YoY, lasting the down trend since 2011; investment in hydropower reached 44.4 billion yuan, up by 45.5% YoY. Besides, investment in nuclear power and wind power were 25.4 billion yuan and 14.3 billion yuan, down by 1.6% and 24.9% YoY, respectively. Investment in thermal power accounted for 25.85% of the total investment in power generation, 8.1 percentage points lower than the same period of 2011; investment in thermal power, nuclear power and wind power accounted for 73.6%, representing an obviously rise. Slightly down of investment in power generation won’t necessarily make copper consumption in power industry down, because copper consumption per clean energy will increase, together with lower prices due to lower prices in 2012 than 2011.
